response.sql: WITH ch AS (SELECT o.orderbase AS base, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_rate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase), bench AS (SELECT AVG(f.feerate) AS b FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault) SELECT AVG(ch.avg_rate) AS mean_avg_fee_rate, AVG(ch.avg_rate - bench.b) AS mean_excess FROM ch CROSS JOIN bench WHERE ch.avg_rate > bench.b
